projects.label: Projects
projects.title: Work I'm proud of
projects.subtitle: Real projects live on the internet, from idea to launch.

items.vortex: A web gaming platform with 11 classic games (Snake, Tetris, 2048, Space Invaders and more), a premium dark design and an interactive 3D background, with a full login system and complete mobile support.
items.mrn: An online store for men's accessories (bracelets, rings, necklaces, sunglasses) from Basra, with a minimalist ivory-and-copper design. It includes instant search and filtering, a shopping bag, ordering via WhatsApp with a gift option, and a protected dashboard for managing products, prices and availability.
items.kai: An online streetwear store with a luxurious dark identity, designed for mobile. Customers browse products with photos and sizes, add them to the bag, fill in their details and get cash on delivery across all Iraqi governorates, then send the order through Instagram. All content is managed from an online dashboard.
items.yrmin: A responsive website for a Lebanese restaurant in Riyadh, with dark and light modes, an interactive tabbed menu, a map, and a contact form that sends reservations via WhatsApp.
